description: Creates a real appointment with the vertebrologist on the user's behalf. Takes date (YYYY-MM-DD) and time (HH:MM), both required; the slot must be one returned by get_availability. Returns ok=true with the booked date and time, or ok=false with a reason: taken (the slot is no longer free; the call fails rather than quietly moving the user to a different time), day_limit (this patient already has an appointment that day — the limit is one per calendar day), locked (the doctor closed that day or slot), past, invalid, error. Authorization required: a one-time Telegram OAuth consent with scope booking:write, which also covers later calls.

date.description: Appointment date, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Kyiv). Must be a day returned by get_availability.

time.description: Slot start, HH:MM in 24-hour form, exactly as get_availability returned it. Slots are 20 minutes.
